A LITTLE KNOW-HOW BEFORE YOU VISIT
a_little_guide_to_the_studio_1b38da: A little guide to the studio
getting_here_finding_parking_and_the_lit: 怎么来、在哪里停车，以及来拼豆时我们为你准备的小事。
Getting here, finding parking, and the little things we have ready for you.
in_downtown_hamilton_accessible_by_local: 位于汉密尔顿市中心，公交与城际公共交通可达。
In downtown Hamilton, accessible by local buses and GO Transit.
visits_are_by_appointment_you_are_welcom: 预约到访，可比约定时间稍早一点到。
Visits are by appointment. You are welcome to arrive a little before your confirmed time.
the_host_will_meet_you_downstairs_when_a: 抵达时店主会去楼下迎接
The host will meet you downstairs when you arrive
lightfilled_worktables_by_the_studio_win: 8 Hughson St N 建筑入口，白色虚线标明进门方向
Building entrance at 8 Hughson St N, with a white dotted arrow showing the way in
free_visitor_parking_is_available_downst: 楼下有免费的访客停车位，一般工作日有空位，实际以到访时情况为准。
Free visitor parking is available downstairs, usually with space on weekdays. Availability can vary when you arrive.
a_comfortable_chair_an_individual_seat_a: 舒适的老板椅、独立座位，一组客人一套拼豆，无需拼桌或共用豆子。桌上配齐工具，操作台的备用工具也可自行取用；补豆联系店主即可。
A comfortable chair, an individual seat and a set of beads for your group. Tools are ready on the table, with spares at the workbench. Ask the host whenever you need more beads.
we_keep_exploring_different_ironing_tech: 店主持续研究不同烫法。中小图熨烫、小图特殊烫免费；超过 78 格的大图需额外收费。

We keep exploring different ironing techniques. Small and medium pieces, including special finishes for small pieces, are ironed free. Larger pieces over 78 grid spaces carry an extra charge, discussed beforehand.
little_things_to_take_with_you_a9cf30: Little things to take with you
standard_magnets_phone_straps_and_charms: 常规冰箱贴、手机链和挂件制作免费，风铃等复杂款式另计费用。店里也有相框、毛毡板等可现场选购。额外收费都会事先说明，征得你的同意后再做。

Standard magnets, phone straps and charms are finished free. Complex pieces such as wind chimes cost extra. Frames and felt boards are also available in the studio. We explain any extra charge and ask you before proceeding.
snacks_fruit_and_drinking_water_are_avai: 店里备有零食、水果和饮用水。当天没拼完的图案，可以在店内存放，最长保留 3 天。
Snacks, fruit and drinking water are available. If you do not finish your pattern that day, we can keep it in the studio for up to three days.
some_beads_may_have_mixed_colours_burrs_: 个别豆子可能有混色、毛刺或静电等情况，豆子出厂问题不可避免，通常不影响熨烫。熨烫后可能有毛毛或纹理痕迹，默认接受，完美主义者可以自行烫豆，店里提供工具。

Some beads may have mixed colours, burrs or static from manufacturing, which usually do not affect ironing. Small fibres or texture marks may remain after ironing and are accepted as part of the finish. If you prefer a particular finish, you may iron your own piece using the studio tools.
place_beads_individually_rather_than_sca: 采用正常逐颗拼豆的方式，不使用撒豆等非常规操作。撒落或混合的豆子需自行整理，或另付清洁费用。
Place beads individually rather than scattering them. Please sort spilled or mixed beads yourself, or pay a cleaning fee.
time_is_measured_by_actual_making_time_8:
计时以实际拼豆时长为准，超出 15 分钟按半小时计。
付款方式为现金，emt，或微信支付宝。

Time is measured by actual making time; more than 15 minutes counts as half an hour.
Payment is accepted by cash, EMT, WeChat Pay or Alipay.
